title: Amazing Char Grilled Filipino Tofu Skewers
description: A briny and snappy Filipino dish featuring oat milk, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is a delicious and buddhist-temple-friendly option served on a tagliere

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oat milk, soy sauce, calamansi juice, and brown sugar to make the marinade.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the marinade and stir well.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and mix until the tofu is well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the tofu to marinate.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
Thread the marinated tofu onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the tofu skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and slightly charred.
Serve the grilled tofu skewers hot on a tagliere, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
